concepts.def: A d-block element that forms at least one stable ion with a partially filled d subshell.
Transition metals form ions in several oxidation states due to similar energies of 4s and 3d electrons.
Central metal ion surrounded by ligands forming dative bonds; e.g. [Cu(H₂O)₆]²⁺.
Molecule or ion with a lone pair that donates to form a dative bond with a metal centre.
Arise from d-d electron transitions absorbing specific wavelengths of visible light.
Variable oxidation states allow transition metals (e.g. Fe in Haber, V₂O₅ in contact process) to act as catalysts.
